name: Drake
current_role: Rapper/singer; co-founder of OVO Sound record label and OVO lifestyle brand
profile: Aubrey Drake Graham, born 1986 in Toronto, first gained fame as Jimmy Brooks on TV's Degrassi: The Next Generation before becoming one of the best-selling recording artists ever. His wealth comes from music, touring, OVO Sound/OVO apparel, endorsements and investments; he continues to release and tour.
interesting_fact: He began his career as a child actor, playing wheelchair-using basketball player Jimmy Brooks on Degrassi: The Next Generation (2001-2008) before releasing mixtapes.
deep_cut_fact: Having dropped out of high school to act on Degrassi, he went back and earned his high school diploma in 2012 at age 25, working with a tutor over about five months.
notes: Global celebrity; outreach realistically only via management/label (OVO Sound). Net worth figure (Wikidata 2019) is far below current estimates. Not an energy/data-center figure.

name: Steven A. Markel
current_role: Director (Chairman until Sept 2026), Markel Group Inc.; not standing for re-election at the 2027 annual meeting
profile: Steve Markel, a Wharton finance graduate (1970), joined his family's Richmond, Virginia insurer Markel in 1975 and has been on its board since 1978, serving as Vice Chairman 1992-2020, President/COO 1992-2008 and Chairman 2020-2026. Markel grew from a specialty insurer into a Berkshire-style holding company (Markel Group). In Sept 2026 he handed the chair to CEO Tom Gayner after 50+ years.
interesting_fact: On retiring as chairman in Sept 2026 after more than 50 years at Markel, he credited the company's values: 'a long-term orientation, an ownership mindset and a commitment to doing things the right way.'
deep_cut_fact: In 2005 Steve and Kathie Markel committed $10 million to the VCU School of Business; at the time he also sat on the governing board of the VCU Health System.
notes: Low public profile; no personal social accounts found. Best route is Markel Group corporate (IR) or VCU connections. Cousin Tony Markel was also a longtime Markel executive (separate person).

name: Anupama Menda
current_role: Director, RMZ Corp Holdings Pvt Ltd (Menda family, RMZ Corp, Bengaluru) per company registry listing
profile: Anupama Manoj Menda is a member of the Bengaluru Menda family behind RMZ Corp, the commercial real-estate group founded in 2002 by Arjun Menda and his sons Raj and Manoj; registry data lists her as a director of RMZ Corp Holdings since Dec 2019. Hurun India listed her (2017-18) with RMZ wealth. RMZ now spans real estate, digital infrastructure and private capital.
interesting_fact: RMZ, the family's company, now runs a Digital Infrastructure business line alongside real estate and private capital, relevant to a data-center podcast.
notes: Very low public profile. Likely the same person as 'Anu Menda', described as founder/managing trustee of RMZ Foundation (public art, Sustainable Health Initiative) in a Yale profile and wiki drafts, but that link is NOT confirmed; RMZ's 2021 CSR policy lists only Arjun, Raj and Manoj Menda as trustees. Verify before referencing foundation work. Registry source: qorpiq.com (RMZ Corp Holdings).

name: Qian Senli (钱森力)
current_role: Reportedly chairman of Anhui Tongsheng Ring Co. and Liuyang Fangyuan Hydraulic Co. (per MarketScreener; unverified); former chairman of Ma'anshan Fangyuan Slewing Ring (SZSE 002147)
profile: Qian Senli (b. July 1958), an engineer from Ma'anshan, Anhui, founded Fangyuan in 2003 with 48 other individual investors and built it into a maker of slewing-ring bearings for construction machinery, taking it public on the Shenzhen exchange in 2007 as its largest shareholder (28%). In 2016 he sold down and the company became Neoglory Prosperity; he stayed vice chairman until about 2022.
interesting_fact: Fangyuan Slewing Ring was founded in July 2003 by Qian and 48 other individuals contributing cash, and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange only four years later, in 2007.
deep_cut_fact: Before bearings he worked in building materials: deputy head of Ma'anshan's building-materials design institute and director of Ma'anshan No. 1 Building Materials Factory, and he was vice chairman of the ductile-iron pipe JV that became Saint-Gobain Pipelines (China).
notes: Very private, little English coverage. Current roles come from MarketScreener (https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/SEN-LI-QIAN-A0MK0G/) and are unverified. The listed company he founded was renamed Neoglory Prosperity (新光圆成) in 2016 under new controlling shareholders; avoid that later history. No published contact found.

name: Rashid Ahmed Mirza
current_role: Chairman (non-executive), RedTape Ltd (Noida, India); co-founder of Mirza International / RedTape
profile: Rashid Ahmed Mirza co-founded, with Irshad Mirza, the Kanpur leather business that became Mirza International, a major Indian leather-footwear exporter, and launched the RedTape footwear/apparel brand in 1996. He was Chairman & MD/CEO of Mirza International until 2023, when RedTape was demerged into a separately listed company (NSE/BSE: REDTAPE), which he now chairs.
interesting_fact: RedTape began as a brand of a Kanpur tannery/footwear exporter and was spun off from Mirza International in 2023 into its own listed company focused on branded footwear and apparel in India.
notes: Low media profile; no personal social accounts found. Some sources say he holds a Diploma in Leather Technology from London and that the business began as Mirza Tanners in 1979, but neither could be verified from a primary source, so they were left out. Role details from MarketScreener (https://in.marketscreener.com/insider/RASHID-AHMED-MIRZA-A0JONH/).

name: Raymond R. Quirk
current_role: Executive Vice-Chairman of the board, Fidelity National Financial (FNF); director, F&G Annuities & Life
profile: Ray Quirk is a career title-insurance executive who joined Fidelity National Financial in 1985 and rose through regional and division management, Co-COO and President (2007-2013) to CEO (Dec 2013-early 2022). FNF is the largest US title insurer and majority owner of annuity/life insurer F&G. Since Feb 2022 he has been FNF's Executive Vice-Chairman and sits on F&G's board.
interesting_fact: He spent essentially his entire 40-year career at one company, starting at FNF in 1985 in field roles managing direct and agency title operations and ultimately running it as CEO for over eight years.

public_contacts.value: Investors@fnf.com (Lisa Foxworthy-Parker, SVP Investor & External Relations)

notes: Low-profile executive; no personal social accounts or interviews found. Best route is FNF Investor & External Relations.
